ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Executable File Creation
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detect creation of suspicious executable file names.
Some strings look for suspicious file extensions, others look for filenames that exploit unquoted service paths.

sequences.query: (file_path = RGX("\\:\\\\\\$Recycle\\\.Bin\\\.exe$") OR file_path = RGX("\\:\\\\Documents\\ and\\ Settings\\\.exe$") OR file_path = RGX("\\:\\\\MSOCache\\\.exe$") OR file_path = RGX("\\:\\\\PerfLogs\\\.exe$") OR file_path = RGX("\\:\\\\Recovery\\\.exe$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.bat\\\.exe$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.sys\\\.exe$"))
